It is not looks, and it is not where he is right now.

Kevin Trudeau says that in interviews and surveys, the vast majority of women are drawn to a man who knows where he is going. Not where he is at. Where he is going.

He says drive and determination are among the most attractive qualities when it comes to choosing who to date.

What do you find most attractive in a partner?
